# Third-party notices

`ScreenReader.Edge` was taken from the attached LazySkald project. It is a C# adaptation
of the Edge speech protocol and v2 token algorithm from [rany2/edge-tts](https://github.com/rany2/edge-tts).
Copyright rany and edge-tts contributors. Licensed under LGPL-3.0-or-later.
See [LGPL](licenses/edge-tts-LICENSE.txt) and [GPL](licenses/GPL-3.0.txt).
The source and its `ScreenReader.Speech` dependency are included here. Run
`dotnet build ScreenReader.Edge` from the directory containing this notice to rebuild the
separate, replaceable DLL.

[NAudio](https://github.com/naudio/NAudio) 2.2.1 — Mark Heath and contributors, [MIT](licenses/NAudio-MIT.txt).


The bundled OBS renderer uses [three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) 0.180.0
([MIT](licenses/three-MIT.txt)) and [postprocessing](https://github.com/pmndrs/postprocessing)
6.38.2 ([Zlib](licenses/postprocessing-Zlib.txt)).
